name: Personalization Product Recommendations
description: Renders a Salesforce Personalization recommendation zone. Tiles are hydrated live via SCAPI Shopper Products at request time by default, or via the storefront's native product tile per Render Mode below, so pricing/promo/availability are never stale.

attribute_definitions.name: Title
attribute_definitions.description: Optional headline shown above the recommendation zone. Leave blank to omit.

attribute_definitions.name: Personalization Point Name
attribute_definitions.description: Salesforce Personalization point/decision name to request for this component instance. Leave blank to resolve via the Point Name Map (using Context Key below) or, failing that, the site-wide Personalization Point Name preference.

attribute_definitions.name: Max Tiles
attribute_definitions.description: Maximum number of product tiles to render for this instance (enter a number, e.g. 8). Leave blank to fall back to the site-wide Max Tiles preference. Also capped by SCAPI's 24-id-per-call batch limit.

attribute_definitions.name: Context Key
attribute_definitions.description: Business-user-assigned key identifying this slot (e.g. "home-hero", "pdp-similar"), looked up in the site's Point Name Map (ps_pointNameMap) to resolve a personalization point when Personalization Point Name above is left blank. Leave blank if using an explicit Personalization Point Name.

attribute_definitions.name: Render Mode
attribute_definitions.description: How this instance turns personalization product ids into tiles. "scapi" hydrates client-side via SCAPI Shopper Products (needs SCAPI/SLAS Site Preferences configured). "sfra" instead fetches the storefront's native, already-cached product tile (Tile-Show) per id - no SCAPI/SLAS setup required, and it reflects logged-in/customer-group pricing.
